title: Mai Gina Girman Kai
intro: A cikin tsohuwar ƙasar da ke ƙarƙashin mulkin wani mai taurin kai, wani mutum mai muhimmanci ya riƙe muƙamin tasiri. Wannan ruhi ya taka muhimmiyar rawa a cikin manyan makircin mai mulki, yana ba da gudummawa ga mulkin zaluncinsu da kuma ƙalubalantar saƙon Allah. Gadonsu yana da alaƙa da neman iko na duniya da kuma musanta gaskiya.
clues: Na yi wa wani babban sarki hidima wanda ya zalunci al'umma tsawon tsararraki da yawa.
Ana yawan ambaton sunana a cikin Littafin Allah tare da wannan shugaba mai iko.
An ba ni aikin gina wani babban gini, wani babban gini da aka yi niyya don isa sama.
Na shawarci shugabana ya kashe 'ya'yan Bani Isra'ila maza ya kuma bar musu 'ya'ya mata.
Na shiga cikin makirci da makirci a kan wani babban manzon Allah.
Ƙarshena, tare da maigidana da rundunarsa, ya zo cikin ruwan teku mai girma.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Ana jarabtar ku da dukiya mai yawa
Jagoranci runduna a kan wani gida mai tsarki
Gina hasumiya don isa ga Allah
A jefa su cikin wuta saboda imaninsu
trial.answer: Gina hasumiya don isa ga Allah

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ana ba shi hikima mai girma
